```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run in dry-run mode (validate only, no publishing)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g., 0.4.2). If not provided, auto-increment patch version.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  MAVEN_OPTS: -Xmx4g
  JAVA_VERSION: 22
  MAVEN_VERSION: 3.9.9

jobs:
  validate-secrets:
    name: Validate Required Secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check required secrets
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}" ]]; then
            echo "SONATYPE_USERNAME secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}" ]]; then
            echo "SONATYPE_PASSWORD secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" ]]; then
            echo "GPG_PRIVATE_KEY secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" ]]; then
            echo "GPG_PASSPHRASE secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" ]]; then
            echo "DOCKERHUB_USER secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "DOCKERHUB_TOKEN secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "RELEASE_TOKEN secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi

  prepare-version:
    name: Prepare Release Version
    needs: validate-secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      is-dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up JDK ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Set up Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: ${{ env.MAVEN_VERSION }}

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]]; then
            echo "version=${{ inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # Auto-increment patch version
            CURRENT_VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
            echo "Current version: $CURRENT_VERSION"
            # Remove -SNAPSHOT suffix for version calculation
            BASE_VERSION=${CURRENT_VERSION%-SNAPSHOT}
            IFS='.' read -ra VERSION_PARTS <<< "$BASE_VERSION"
            PATCH_VERSION=$((VERSION_PARTS[2] + 1))
            NEW_VERSION="${VERSION_PARTS[0]}.${VERSION_PARTS[1]}.$PATCH_VERSION"
            echo "version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  build-and-test:
    name: Build and Test
    needs: prepare-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up JDK ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Set up Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: ${{ env.MAVEN_VERSION }}

      - name: Build with Maven
        run: |
          mvn clean install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          mvn test -DenableH2Tests=true

  publish-artifacts:
    name: Publish to Maven Central & Docker Hub
    needs: [prepare-version, build-and-test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ !needs.prepare-version.outputs.is-dry-run }}
    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up JDK ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Set up Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: ${{ env.MAVEN_VERSION }}

      - name: Import GPG key
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Publish to Maven Central
        run: |
          mvn clean deploy -Prelease -DskipTests
        env:
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        run: |
          mvn compile jib:build -pl ojp-server \
            -Djib.to.auth.username="${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" \
            -Djib.to.auth.password="${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -Djib.to.image="rrobetti/ojp:${{ needs.prepare-version.outputs.version }}" \
            -Djib.container.mainClass="org.openjproxy.grpc.server.GrpcServer" \
            -Djib.container.ports=1059

  update-documentation:
    name: Update Documentation
    needs: [prepare-version, publish-artifacts]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ !needs.prepare-version.outputs.is-dry-run }}
    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update version references in markdown files
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ needs.prepare-version.outputs.version }}"
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/ojp:\([0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\)/ojp:$VERSION/g" {} \;
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/0\.4\.1/$VERSION/g" {} \;
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/0\.4\.1-SNAPSHOT/$VERSION/g" {} \;

      - name: Commit documentation updates
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "docs: update version references to ${{ needs.prepare-version.outputs.version }}" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push documentation updates
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
